repairs.quote: Passive: Warwick can sense champions below 50% Health, gaining 35/42.5/50/57.5/65% Move Speed towards them. Spells and attacks against enemies below 50% Health grant 70/80/90/100/110% Attack Speed. These effects are increased by 200% against enemies below 25% Health. Active: Warwick can briefly sense all enemies, and gains this Ability's passive effect against the closest champion for 8 seconds, regardless of Health. If no champions are found, this Ability's cooldown is reduced by 30%. Warwick can only passively sense enemies who were brought below 50% Health by allies.
